notes: Terrain tile overlays (F3 Terrain Tile Overlay) on TEST_PROFILES: Create from OSM at the view's centre through terrainOverlayTool (the harness's overlay key), drawn from the local OSM directory (--set core.paths.osmData=<converted Poland files>), shown on the map and in 3D. Then at 50 % opacity: the overlay blended over the terrain (a decal on paged terrain in 3D).
